# Vojislav Miloradovic - Machine-Readable Credentials Archive

> **Last Generated:** 2026-09-11 02:29 UTC
> Curated, structured, and token-optimized record of professional certifications, badges, and learning achievements across Microsoft Learn, AWS, Google Cloud, Credly, LinkedIn, and Google Developer.

## Portfolio Overview & Total Counts
- **Microsoft Learn**: 35,862 completed units | 4,831 total achievements | 6,029,450 XP
- **Google Cloud Skills**: 390 badges
- **AWS Skill Builder**: 819 completed courses/activities
- **Credly**: 618 credentials
- **LinkedIn**: 1,644 verified external certifications
- **Google Developer**: 172 milestone badges | 1,632 codelabs & activities
